summary: National Presto Industries filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its Bylaws (advance notice provisions, universal proxy rules, remote meeting rules) and the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting (director re-election, ratification of auditor, advisory say-on-pay). These are routine governance and meeting items. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other transformative corporate actions. The filing does not contain deal terms, price, or premium information.
